node.title: Re: writing to filter giving me back GLOB(x)GLOB(x)...
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
print $spamc_h for @$de_cluttered_msg;

A bare print; will use $_, but print $handle; will print the contents of $handle to the currently [doc://select]ed output handle. You need to say print $spamc_h $_ for @$de_cluttered_msg; instead.
